class SecretDetector : Detector(), SourceCodeScanner, XmlScanner {

    companion object {
        private val SECRET_PATTERN = Regex(
            "(api[_-]?key|secret|password|passwd|pwd|token|auth|credential)",
            RegexOption.IGNORE_CASE

            briefDescription = "Secret in source code",
            explanation = """

            """.trimIndent(),

                EnumSet.of(Scope.JAVA_FILE, Scope.RESOURCE_FILE),
                EnumSet.of(Scope.JAVA_FILE),
                EnumSet.of(Scope.RESOURCE_FILE)
            )
        )
    }

        return listOf(ULiteralExpression::class.java)
    }

    override fun createUastHandler(context: JavaContext): UElementHandler {
        return object : UElementHandler() {
            override fun visitLiteralExpression(node: ULiteralExpression) {
                val value = node.value
                if (value is String) {
                    if (looksLikeSecret(value)) {
                        context.report(
                            ISSUE,
                            node,
                            context.getLocation(node),
                            MESSAGE
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun getApplicableElements(): Collection<String>? {
        return XmlScanner.ALL
    }

    override fun visitElement(context: XmlContext, element: Element) {
        // Check element text content
        val text = element.textContent
        if (text != null && text.isNotBlank() && looksLikeSecret(text)) {
            context.report(
                ISSUE,
                element,
                context.getLocation(element),
                MESSAGE
            )
        }
    }

    override fun getApplicableAttributes(): Collection<String>? {
        return XmlScanner.ALL
    }

    override fun visitAttribute(context: XmlContext, attribute: Attr) {
        val value = attribute.value ?: return
        if (value.isBlank()) return
        if (looksLikeSecret(value)) {
            context.report(
                ISSUE,
                attribute,
                context.getValueLocation(attribute),
                MESSAGE
            )
        }
    }

    private fun looksLikeSecret(value: String): Boolean {
        return SECRET_PATTERN.containsMatchIn(value)
    }
}

                        ISSUE,
                        node,
                        context.getLocation(node),
                        MESSAGE

            }
        }

    private fun looksLikeSecretValue(value: String): Boolean {
        return GOOGLE_MAPS_KEY_PATTERN.matches(value) || GENERIC_SECRET_PATTERN.matches(value)

                context.getLocation(element),
                MESSAGE

        return null

                attribute,
                context.getValueLocation(attribute),
                MESSAGE
            )
        }

            context.report(ISSUE, attr, context.getValueLocation(attr), MESSAGE)

            context.report(ISSUE, element, context.getLocation(element), MESSAGE)

    }

    while (child != null) {
        if (child.nodeType == Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
            checkElement(context, child as Element)
        }
        child = child.nextSibling
    }
}
